android.desc:
Fasting - Intermittent Fasting is more than skipping meals. It's a research-backed practice that changes how your body uses energy. Fasti is a clean, distraction-free fasting tracker built around the methods and metabolic science that actually work.
CHOOSE YOUR FASTING METHOD

16:8 fasting (the most popular starting point)
18:6 fasting
20:4 fasting
OMAD (one meal a day)
5:2 diet
Warrior Diet
Alternate day fasting
Custom windows from 12 hours up to extended fasts

Pick a method, set your eating window, and start. The fasting timer runs quietly in the background and notifies you when each phase begins and ends.
WHAT HAPPENS WHEN YOU FAST
Your body moves through clear metabolic stages during a fast. The app surfaces each one in real time so you understand what is happening inside, not just how long is left.

Hours 0 to 4: Digestion and insulin response
Hours 4 to 12: Blood glucose stabilises and glycogen stores begin to deplete
Hours 12 to 16: Fat metabolism activates as the body looks for new fuel
Hours 16 to 24: Ketosis begins, fatty acids convert to ketones for energy
Hours 24 and beyond: Autophagy ramps up, the cellular renewal process the body uses to recycle damaged proteins

Research on time-restricted eating points to improved insulin sensitivity, steadier energy through the day, reduced inflammation, and better metabolic markers over time. The app gives you the clarity to track all of it.
CORE FEATURES

Precise fasting clock with eating window countdown
Real-time metabolic stage indicator (digestion, fat metabolism, ketosis, autophagy)
Body progress tracker with weekly trend charts
Water intake log with smart hydration reminders
Calorie counter for your eating window
Streak tracker and gentle habit building
Daily journal to log energy, mood, and sleep
Clean, distraction-free design that stays out of your way

BUILT FOR REAL LIFE
Skip a day, no guilt. Travel across time zones and the timer adjusts. Fast clean or dirty, your choice. The app gives you the structure, you stay in control.
ALSO SUPPORTS TRADITIONAL FASTING
If you observe Ekadashi, Ramadan with Sehri and Iftar timings, Navratri, Karva Chauth, Pradosh Vrat, Sankashti Chaturthi, Janmashtami, Sawan Somvar, or Paryushan, you can log those fasts in the same place. Your streak counts the same whether the fast is for health or for tradition.
